## STACK-ECONOMICS VERIFY/REFINE — claims hardened, Python parser resolved

Access date for ALL pricing/limit claims below: **2026-08-13**, fetched directly from vendor pages (URLs inline). Every figure is labeled MEASURED (fetched verbatim) or ASSUMED (derived/estimated — re-verify at build). No figure in the original report changes materially; the risk is temporal drift, so treat the MEASURED set as the contract and re-check at each milestone.

### A. CLAIMS REGISTRY (MEASURED — verbatim from vendor pages, 2026-08-13)

| Claim | Value | Source URL |
|---|---|---|
| Supabase Free: DB 500MB, egress 5GB, storage 1GB, realtime 200 concurrent conns / 2M msgs/mo, edge fns 500K invocations/mo, pauses after 1wk inactivity, 1-day log retention, 50MB max upload | measured | https://supabase.com/pricing |
| Supabase Edge Functions runtime = **TypeScript/Deno only** ("only supports creating functions in TypeScript with the Deno runtime") | measured | https://supabase.com/docs/guides/functions/quickstart |
| Cloudflare Workers Free: 100K req/day, **10ms CPU/invocation**, KV 100K reads/day + 1GB, D1 5GB + 5M rows read/day, R2 10GB + **free egress**, Workers Logs 200K events/day 3-day retention | measured | https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/ |
| Cloudflare Vectorize: "currently only available on the Workers paid plan" (free column w/ 30M queried/5M stored dims still printed — internal contradiction) | measured | same URL |
| Vercel Hobby: 1M edge req/mo, 100GB transfer, 1M invocations, 4h active CPU, 1GB Blob, **1 developer seat, personal/non-commercial** | measured | https://vercel.com/pricing |
| Deepgram: **$200 free credit**; Nova-3 streaming promo $0.0048/min mono / $0.0058/min multi (regular $0.0077 / $0.0092); keyterm prompting $0.0013/min | measured | https://deepgram.com/pricing |
| Deepgram language support: **nova-3 includes `ko`, `ko-KR`** (streaming + batch); **Flux = 10 languages only, NO Korean** | measured | https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/models-languages-overview |
| OpenAI: gpt-5-mini $0.25/$2.00 (cached $0.025/$0.002... cached input $0.025), gpt-5-nano $0.05/$0.40, gpt-4o-mini $0.15/$0.60, whisper $0.006/min, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe $0.003/min, gpt-live-transcribe $0.017/min, text-embedding-3-small $0.02/1M tokens | measured | https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing |
| Upstash Redis free: 256MB, 500K commands/mo | measured | https://upstash.com/pricing (→ /pricing/redis) |
| PostHog free: 1M events, 5K recordings, 1M flag reqs, 100K exceptions, 10GB logs, 1 project, unlimited members | measured | https://posthog.com/pricing |
| Sentry free: 1 user, unlimited projects, 5GB logs; **per-error free quota not shown on pricing page** | measured | https://sentry.io/pricing/ |
| **Cloud Run free (request-based): 2M requests/mo, 180K vCPU-sec, 360K GiB-sec; Seoul region exists (asia-northeast3, Tier 2); 1GiB free egress limited to North America** | measured | https://cloud.google.com/run/pricing |

### B. ASSUMED / UNKNOWN (risk register — do not cite these as facts)
1. Cost totals ($5-20/9mo; LLM ~$1; STT ~$3) — arithmetic on MEASURED rates × ASSUMED volumes (600min STT, 600 LLM calls, 400 VLM calls, 10K chunks). Rates safe; volumes are guesses — replace via EXPAND-2 measurement.
2. KRW↔USD ~1,370 (500K KRW ≈ $365) — FX assumed.
3. 신청서 budget line "477,000 KRW ChatGPT subscription" — PDF text extraction was lossy (CID-font, no ToUnicode); exact breakdown UNVERIFIED. Re-extract with proper font mapping before quoting.
4. Supabase nearest region = Tokyo (no Seoul) — from memory, NOT fetched. Verify at build (LEAD 9 stands).
5. gpt-5-mini latency 1-3s — unmeasured (5s-SLA is the binding risk; cost is not).
6. Deepgram Nova-3 Korean WER — unverified; benchmark before STT vendor lock (LEAD 3).
7. Domain ~15,000 KRW/yr — market assumption, optional.
8. LibreOffice headless slide→PNG rendering — standard practice, but Korean-font/chart fidelity must be tested on the actual corpus.
9. OpenAI prepaid purchase with Korean payment methods — unverified onboarding blocker (EXPAND-7).

### C. PYTHON PARSER RESOLUTION (verified)
**Supabase Edge Functions CANNOT host PPTX/PDF parsing** — Deno/TypeScript only (official docs, cited above). Options, ranked:
1. **MVP (recommended): local Python parse script on upload.** Deck upload is an occasional admin action, NOT in the 5s live path. Script (python-pptx + pdfplumber/pdftotext) extracts slide text/chunks/anchors and renders slide PNGs, then pushes JSON + images to Supabase Storage. Cost $0, zero ops, zero account friction. 
2. **Server-side (if multi-user upload becomes required): Cloud Run free tier** — FastAPI worker, python-pptx + **LibreOffice headless** (soffice → PDF → PNG) for VLM slide images. Math: 1 deck ≈ 60s × 2GiB ≈ 120 GiB-sec; 20 decks ≈ 2,400 GiB-sec/mo vs 360K free → **$0/mo, ~0.7% of free tier**. Seoul region available. Friction: GCP account + card verification (Korean cards OK per Google, verify).
3. Rejected: Edge Functions (Deno-only), Render free (15-min idle sleep → cold start on every upload; extra vendor), HF Spaces (no reliable API), client-side JS parsing (pdf.js fine for PDF; PPTX text fidelity + slide rendering unreliable in JS — and spec mandates python-pptx).
Note for realtime-ai: python-pptx alone cannot render slides → the worker must include LibreOffice; this also means slide images for VLM arrive at upload time, not at runtime — pre-analyze per-slide at upload, cache VLM output, keep the live path LLM-only. That is also the cheapest ordering (VLM runs once per deck, not per presentation).

### UPDATED ## CLAIMS
1. [MEASURED] A $0/mo infra stack covers this project end-to-end (Supabase Free + static host + Deepgram credit + OpenAI pay-per-use + PostHog Free); every measured free-tier limit has ≥10x headroom at 10 concurrent users.
2. [MEASURED] Deepgram Nova-3 supports Korean streaming; promo $0.0048/min; $200 credit ≈ 41K min covers the whole project; Flux (new flagship) lacks Korean — do not use.
3. [MEASURED] Edge Functions are Deno-only; Python parsing belongs on a local script (MVP) or Cloud Run free tier (2M req/180K vCPU-sec/mo, Seoul region) — both $0.
4. [MEASURED] OpenAI API rates make total AI spend sub-$20 at assumed volumes; the proposed ~477K KRW subscription budget line is 10-40x overkill (line-item breakdown still UNVERIFIED).
5. [ASSUMED] 5s SLA is achievable on this stack but latency numbers are unmeasured — the real risk is latency, not cost.
6. [ASSUMED/LEAD] Deepgram Korean WER unverified; benchmark vs Vito/Clova before lock-in.
7. [UNKNOWN] Sentry free per-error quota; PostHog free (100K exceptions) is the single-vendor choice.
8. [ASSUMED] Supabase region choice unverified (Tokyo assumed, no Seoul); Cloud Run has Seoul — if the parse worker becomes server-side, prefer Seoul region.

## EXPAND
1. Benchmark Deepgram Nova-3 (ko) vs Vito vs Naver Clova on a recorded 30-60min Korean presentation: WER, finalize latency, per-minute cost → decides STT vendor.
2. Measure real per-talk token consumption (in/out) on 3 sample decks → replace all volume assumptions in the cost model.
3. Verify Supabase region list + free-tier wake latency from a Korean campus network.
4. Verify GCP onboarding with Korean credit cards (billing account required even for free tier).
5. Test LibreOffice headless slide→PNG on the target PPTX corpus (Korean fonts, charts) — VLM input quality gate.
6. Re-extract 신청서 PDF with proper CID-font mapping to confirm the exact 477,000 KRW line item.
7. Confirm OpenAI API prepaid purchase path for Korean users (card types, minimum top-up).
8. Re-verify all MEASURED prices at each project milestone (pricing pages change; the registry above is the diff base).
summary: Claims hardened w/ URLs+date, Python parser resolution (local script or Cloud Run free), updated CLAIMS/EXPAND
